skill_name: Compare and contrast the US Constitution and the Declaration of Independence.
workflow: The US Constitution and the Declaration of Independence are two of the most important documents in American history. The Declaration of Independence is a statement adopted by the Second Continental Congress in 1776 which declared the colonies' right to self-governance and separation from Great Britain.
